title: Domain Mixture Design via Log-Likelihood Differences for Aligning Language Models with a Target Model
abstract: arXiv:2603.16622v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Instead of directly distilling a language model, this study addresses the problem of aligning a base model with a target model in distribution by designing the domain mixture of training data for pretraining or continued pretraining as a fixed training recipe. We propose a method for determining domain weights by viewing models as points in log-likelihood space and aligning the training update direction with the direction toward the target model. Experiments with NanoGPT show that the proposed method consistently reduces the KL divergence between the trained base model and the target model relative to training with Pile-original weighting. Although knowledge distillation remains more effective when available, the proposed method achieves meaningful alignment, and downstream task performance also tends to become closer to that of the target model.

translated_title: 基于对数似然差异的领域混合设计：用于将语言模型与目标模型对齐
translated_abstract: 本研究并非直接对语言模型进行蒸馏，而是通过将预训练或继续预训练的训练数据领域混合设计为固定的训练配方，来解决将基础模型与目标模型在分布上对齐的问题。我们提出了一种确定领域权重的方法，该方法将模型视为对数似然空间中的点，并使训练更新方向与朝向目标模型的方向对齐。在NanoGPT上的实验表明，与使用Pile原始权重进行训练相比，所提出的方法能够持续降低训练后的基础模型与目标模型之间的KL散度。尽管在可用时知识蒸馏仍然更为有效，但所提出的方法实现了有意义的对齐，且下游任务性能也趋于更接近目标模型的性能。
tldr: 提出了一种基于对数似然差异的领域混合权重设计方法，通过将训练更新方向对齐到目标模型方向，在不使用知识蒸馏的情况下有效降低基础模型与目标模型之间的KL散度。
en_tdlr: Proposes a domain mixture design method based on log-likelihood differences that aligns the training update direction toward a target model, effectively reducing the KL divergence between base and target models without knowledge distillation.
